text.README.md: Records what the Bitbucket skill is based on, the credentials it reads, that lantern-delegate runs it as a subprocess and that it stays self-contained, with a user's own Bitbucket skill taking precedence
text.SKILL.md: Directs an agent to list, show, open, comment on and check Bitbucket pull requests, and to keep a marked block in a description, with the account added in Lantern, taken from the environment or asked of Lantern, never merging, approving, deleting or force-pushing, and leaves what a pull request contains to the user's own templates and skills, found with the conventions command
text.SKILL.md @ skills/lantern-commit/SKILL.m: commit the work first, since opening a pull request never commits
text.SKILL.md @ skills/lantern-bitbucket/scri: the one command the agent runs for every pull request action
